_about: AUTHORED by the game team. Settings for the recorded narration (web/scripts/narration.ts). 'provider' picks the service: 'azure' (Microsoft Azure Speech, default: natural Greek voices, the free tier covers all five languages) or 'elevenlabs'. List the voices a service offers with `npm run narration -- --voices --lang el` in web/. 'say_as' changes how a word is pronounced in the recording only (the screen keeps the original), e.g. the project name ARGUS, which a Greek voice may otherwise spell out. After changing the provider, a voice or the settings, run with `--redo`. Needs review: the voices (listen to a few lines first) and the pronunciation of ARGUS in Greek.
